coaching.title: Easy 6mi Z2 + Strength
coaching.message: Calendar has an easy 6-mile Zone 2 run today, HR 138-150 bpm, conversational effort only — yesterday's big vert session (7mi/1,600ft) was your last major climbing load before Julian Alps, so today is about circulation, not adaptation. Pair it with your final full strength session of the build: eccentric and plyometric durability plus core. After this, loading tapers off — 15 days out, protect this easy day.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: No fueling needed mid-run at this distance/effort — hydrate normally. Bigger priority is the post-strength window: 30-40g protein plus carbs within 60 minutes to support the eccentric/plyometric work. Hit your ~220g carb target today; this is a rest-adjacent day, so keep quality high (whole foods, less processed) rather than maxing intake.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Eccentric and plyometric strength work leaves delayed soreness — foam roll quads/calves tonight and tomorrow morning, 10 minutes of hip and ankle mobility before bed. Aim for 8+ hours of sleep; this is the last day of real strength loading before Julian Alps, so let the taper start doing its job.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: 15 days to Kranjska Gora. You banked the vert yesterday — today isn't about proving fitness, it's about protecting it. Trust that dialing back now is what lets you show up sharp on alpine terrain. The work is done; the discipline now is restraint.
